name: com.kruty1918.levelgen
description: Data-driven, seeded level generation for casual, hybrid-casual and hyper-casual games: runners, puzzles, tower defense, mazes, boards. Levels are described by JSON recipes — an ordered pipeline of generation steps (fill, noise, scatter, path, maze, rooms, segments, placement, symmetry, declarative requirements) with automatic retries. Works standalone with its own GenLevel JSON format; optionally bridges to LevelKit when that package is present.

samples.description: JSON recipes for five game archetypes: endless runner track, match/puzzle board, tower-defense path, maze, and a calm campsite board. Drop them into Resources and call LevelGenerator.Generate.
